Scared AI will misuse your data? Here are three simple rules, so it can't.
Harry runs a phone repair shop. He'd like AI's help, but he has one worry. His customers' data.
The worry is fair. Whatever you paste into an AI app goes to that company. So you decide what goes in.
Meet two Harrys. One avoids AI completely. The other uses it, with three rules.
The first one still types every reply by hand, while the shop next door answers in seconds.
Rule one. Check the training setting. Most AI apps let you switch off training on your chats. Turn it off.
Rule two. Sort your data like a traffic light.
Red. Never paste it. Aadhaar, PAN, passwords, card numbers, O T Ps.
Amber. Hide details first. Sharma jee becomes Customer A. Remove phone and GST numbers.
Green. Safe to share. Price lists, product details, templates, your own drafts.
Rule three. Check every answer before you use it. AI can be wrong.
Now he replies in minutes, and his customers' private details never leave the shop.
Don't avoid AI. Decide what it sees.
